lines.en: I come from the far side.

lines.zh: 我的脚步在场地里回响。
lines.en: My steps echo through the arena.

lines.zh: 我走得不快，你也不会觉得慢。
lines.en: I am not fast; you will not find it slow either.
My soles scrape the floor.
My outline is not quite right.

lines.zh: 我每走一步，地面就暗一点。
lines.en: Each step darkens the ground a little.
I stop at the center.

lines.zh: 我抬脚的时候没有声音。
lines.en: When I lift a foot there is no sound.
I angle toward you.
There is a little red in my eyes.

lines.zh: 我的影子贴在墙上等你。
lines.en: My shadow waits on the wall.
I tilt my head and a joint clicks.
My smile does not reach my eyes.
A needle mouse's hide is sharp.
My chest does not move.

lines.zh: 我眨眼的时候你最好别动。
lines.en: Better not move while I blink.
The arena darkens around us.
I listen to your heartbeat.

lines.zh: 我又站直了，关节响了一声。
lines.en: I straighten up again and my joints crack.

lines.zh: 我在算你还有几步能跑。
lines.en: I am counting how many steps you have left.
I am in no hurry; I stand straight and watch.
I laugh until my shoulders shake.
Do you know this face?

lines.zh: 这里的门只为一个人开。
lines.en: This door opens for one person only.
My eyes are brighter than yours.

lines.zh: 你闻起来像刚跑过很远。
lines.en: You smell like you ran far.
I want to see how fast you run.
Will you run, or stand?
What you hold will not help.
You laughed.
I like that reaction.
I hold out my hand, after you.
My face was stitched together.
There is a mark on my shoulder.
That blow makes me laugh.
This does not matter.

lines.zh: 针鼠的形态，只在这一场。
lines.en: The needle mouse form lasts one fight.

lines.zh: 这一下，我会记在你的账上。
lines.en: That one goes on your tab.

lines.zh: 疼痛只是提醒我，你还活着。
lines.en: Pain only reminds me you're still alive.

lines.zh: 你以为伤到我？我只是换了个笑容。
lines.en: You think that hurt me? I just changed my smile.

lines.zh: 你举的东西我不感兴趣。
lines.en: What you hold does not interest me.
You think you can stall me?
That means nothing to me.

lines.zh: 我这副身子里，塞着东西。
lines.en: Something is stuffed inside this body.

lines.zh: 这一笑，是留给你最后看的。
lines.en: This smile is the last thing you'll see.

lines.zh: 你来了，我等这道声音等了太久。
lines.en: You came — I've waited ages for that sound.

lines.zh: 别跑，你的脚步声就是邀请。
lines.en: Don't run — your footsteps are the invitation.

lines.zh: 再靠近一点，让我看看你的脸。
lines.en: Come a little closer, let me see your face.
You hit me and fall back.

lines.zh: 我的笑声，是从录音带里来的。
lines.en: My laugh comes off a tape.
Your shoulder goes numb.

lines.zh: 我从场地的另一头走过来。
lines.en: I walk in from the far end of the arena.
The light in the arena flickers.

lines.zh: 两颗脑袋撞上，闷响一声。
lines.en: Two heads clashed with a muffled thud.

lines.zh: 我只是让开半步，不是怕。
lines.en: I give half a step, not from fear.
I step right back.
Do not try that again.
There is only me here.
Another form is elsewhere.
I hold this arena alone.
I look up at the dark above.
My shadow is still that long.

lines.zh: 我把手插进口袋，转了一圈。
lines.en: I turn once with my hands in my pockets.
My prints are on the floor.
I am in that pose again.

lines.zh: 我捡起来时关节咔咔响。
lines.en: My joints creak as I bend.
I tuck it into my coat.
This weight is not worth taking.
What falls here is mine.
Crumbs leak through my fingers.
It rolls to your feet and stops.
I look and laugh.

lines.zh: 我用爪子把它挑起来看。
lines.en: I hook it up with my claw to look.
I close it in my hand.
These needles hurt whoever touches them.
When you move, I stop smiling.

lines.zh: 我这张脸缝得歪歪扭扭。
lines.en: This face of mine is stitched crooked.
I lift that familiar face.
I walk at you.
My red eyes flare.
My fingertips are all fine needles.
The arena starts closing in.
Do you hear someone laughing?

lines.zh: 现在，针鼠的针都在外面。
lines.en: Now; the needle mouse's needles are all out.
Closing your eyes won't help.
This match is only us.

lines.zh: 针尖从我的指节冒出来。
lines.en: Needles push out of my knuckles.

lines.zh: 针鼠的 Boss 形态，来了。
lines.en: The Needlemouse boss form has arrived.
One stride puts me ahead.
You turn the other way.
And I am there too.

lines.zh: 你的心跳我数到第八下。
lines.en: I count your heart to the eighth beat.
I am already behind you.
You have reached the edge.
There is no door there.

lines.zh: Boss 形态的我，慢慢地靠近。
lines.en: In boss form, I close in slowly.
My grin splits to my ears.
I extend the other hand.
I raise my hand one last time.

lines.zh: 我的指甲陷进你的衣料。
lines.en: My nails sink into your clothes.

lines.zh: 我的手指扣住你的锁骨。
lines.en: My fingers hook your collarbone.
My fingers dig into your armor.
You hit the wall.
One slap knocks you down.
I walk over.
You are not dead yet.
I pull you up.
I raise my hand again.

lines.zh: 那是你自己的骨头在响。
lines.en: That is your own bone cracking.

lines.zh: 场地的灯灭了，我站在那里。
lines.en: The lights die and I am standing there.
I walk out of the black.
This is the first time I use this form.
Did you hear the door close?
My head comes up slowly.
The walls are closer than before.
There is a ring of shadow on the floor.
Do you still remember my name?
I take the center of the arena.
The air here has changed.
I am no longer that shape.
I open my eyes.
Red shows through my eyes.

lines.zh: 我从走廊尽头慢慢走近。
lines.en: I walk slowly from the hall's end.
I show my teeth.

lines.zh: 灯光闪了一下，我就在这。
lines.en: The light flickers, and here I am.
The door is locked.

lines.zh: 火在我身上烧，我的轮廓抖了抖。
lines.en: Fire burns on me and my outline wavers.

lines.zh: 我从高处落下来，站着落地。
lines.en: I drop from a height and land on my feet.

lines.zh: 水漫上来了，我不呼吸也不怕。
lines.en: Water rises, and needing no breath I do not fear it.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我推出去，我笑了一声。
lines.en: The blast pushes me back and I laugh.

lines.zh: 一支箭插在我胸口，我拔了出来。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my chest and I pull it out.

lines.zh: 咒光打过来，我的红色暗了。
lines.en: Spell-light hits and my red dims.
I do not eat, yet something is draining.

lines.zh: 雷照亮了场地，我站着没动。
lines.en: Lightning lights the arena and I do not stir.

lines.zh: 虚空把我拖下去，我抓着门框。
lines.en: The void drags me down; I grip the door frame.
